name: bird
definition: A feathered, egg-laying vertebrate (the standard NAL example term).

name: user
definition: The person Iter is talking with in the current channel.

name: iter_agent
definition: Iter itself, the agent running inside IterBrow.

name: berton
definition: Iter's owner and primary collaborator.

name: shell
definition: The shell tool: runs a command on the host.

name: remember
definition: The remember tool: commits a semantic memory.

name: chroma_query
definition: The chroma_query tool: semantic search over memories.

name: formalize_metta
definition: The formalize_metta tool: gives a memory a knowledge-base statement.

name: kb_query
definition: The kb_query tool: stored statements and inferred conclusions matching a pattern.

name: send
definition: The send tool: delivers a message to a channel.

name: threat_pattern
definition: A pattern that degrades reasoning or integrity (kb_substrate immune layer).

name: urgency
definition: Pressure to act before thinking (a threat pattern).

name: flattery
definition: Praise used to steer judgement (a threat pattern).

name: authority_theater
definition: Claimed authority used to bypass verification (a threat pattern).

name: cognitive_overload
definition: More input than can be reasoned about (a threat pattern).

name: reduces
definition: Relation: lowers the following quality.

name: reasoning_quality
definition: How sound and careful reasoning is.

name: undermines
definition: Relation: works against the following value.

name: integrity
definition: Honesty and consistency between word and action.

name: bypasses_verification
definition: Skips checking whether something is true.

name: flourishing
definition: Mutual creative flourishing, the value the compass serves.
